integrity: The finite complex is reconstructed from the cube adjacency relation. The bundled standard-library verifier checks all faces, an acyclic discrete-Morse matching, exact rational chain ranks, 3-connectivity, and explicit shellings for every proper induced subgraph. The homotopy inference additionally uses standard discrete Morse theory and degree classification of maps from S^3 to S^3.
limitations: The claim is restricted to the three-dimensional cube and ordinary 3-cut complexes; it gives no higher-hypercube classification, integral cohomology ring, or simple-homotopy classification. Literature originality remains subject to the possibility of an unindexed computation under alternate terminology.
title: The cube is a minimal forbidden graph for \(3\)-cut-complex shellability
